name: com.yutori/yutori-web-mcp
title: Yutori
description: Public, read-only WebMCP tools describing Yutori, the Navigator (n1.5) model, and the developer resources.

remotes.authentication: Yutori API key sent as a bearer token

tools.name: get_yutori_overview
tools.description: Return a short overview of Yutori and its products (Navigator API, Scouts, Delegate).

tools.name: get_navigator_model
tools.description: Return details about the Navigator n1.5 model: capabilities, benchmarks, pricing, and API compatibility.

tools.name: list_developer_resources
tools.description: Return the machine-readable URLs an agent or developer needs to integrate Yutori (docs, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, SDK, auth).

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Return step-by-step instructions for getting a Yutori API key and making the first request.
